archetypes.name: contract-ordering
archetypes.rationale: SKILL.md mandates the stdout write before annotate while cmd_annotate now silently returns 0 on empty/missing stdout — these two changes target the same failure from opposite directions and may remove the diagnostic signal for mandate violations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the 'MANDATORY write' instruction added to SKILL.md Step 5b and the new graceful-skip path in file-design-oos.sh cmd_annotate create conflicting authority. When an orchestrator violates the mandate and never writes oos-issue.stdout.txt, cmd_annotate now returns 0 without writing oos-issues-created.md, then render-final-summary.sh falls back to sentinel — so the mandate violation is silent and undetectable. Note that FILE_DESIGN_OOS_STATUS=annotate-skipped-empty-stdout goes to stdout, but the SKILL.md annotate call only redirects stderr (2>…oos-filing-annotate.stderr.log), so that status is never captured by the orchestrator. Assess whether cmd_annotate's graceful skip should at minimum write a warning to stderr so the orchestrator can surface it, and whether the ordering documentation in file-design-oos.md still accurately reflects the new behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sentinel-count-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The sentinel fallback reads ISSUES_CREATED from oos-issue-sentinel without subtracting ISSUES_FAILED, potentially overcounting, and sets OOS_URLS to a freeform string that downstream renderers may expect to be a URL list or empty.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the elif sentinel fallback added to render-final-summary.sh. Determine whether ISSUES_CREATED in the sentinel represents successfully-filed issues or all attempted issues including failures — if ISSUES_FAILED > 0 during a run, the displayed count could overstate actual GitHub issues created. Check whether the fallback should compute ISSUES_CREATED - ISSUES_FAILED instead of using ISSUES_CREATED directly. Also trace where OOS_URLS is consumed in render-final-summary.sh: if any downstream formatting, paste, or templating expects OOS_URLS to be either a comma-separated URL list or an empty string, setting it to the literal '(URLs unavailable — annotate step was skipped)' may corrupt output or cause unexpected rendering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
